articles.expand: The softer Australian inflation data at the end of July was pretty much the dealbreaker ahead of today's decision. Will there be any hawkish indications still or perhaps some signs of dissent? That will certainly keep things interesting as the threshold for any hawkish surprises isn't exactly high.
